dedupe_keys.name: extreme cold events across 217 us cities

description: Krelling, Malik and Hong publish a curated extreme-cold event list for 217 United States cities and whole-year EnergyPlus Weather files for the years containing those events. The Zenodo record is open under CC BY 4.0 and says events were selected from NASA POWER hourly temperatures for 2001 through 2024 using local percentile thresholds. A building modeller can select an event from the summary spreadsheet and run the matching EPW interval in model-energyplus to test heating demand or thermal resilience. The event selection is relative to each city’s local climate, so a listed cold snap does not mean the same absolute temperature in every city. EPW files represent weather input, not measured indoor conditions or outage outcomes. The archive packages the summary and weather files together, and coverage is the 217 named cities, not all United States locations. I read the own Zenodo metadata and manifest, without downloading the archive, checking individual weather stations or running a simulation.
